'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–2021)|War in Afghanistan]]
**Aftermath of the [[2021 Taliban offensive]] and [[Fall of Kabul (2021)|Fall of Kabul]]
***[[Taliban]] spokesman [[Zabiullah Mujahid]] says that the group will not allow any more evacuations of [[Afghanistan|Afghan citizens]] and that the "main road to the [[Hamid Karzai International Airport|airport]] is now blocked" and that "people should return to work". Mujahid also said that the [[United States]] must stick to [[Withdrawal of United States troops from Afghanistan (2020–2021)|its August 31 withdrawal]] deadline. [https://edition.cnn.com/2021/08/24/asia/kabul-airport-afghanistan-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)]
***[[Operation Pitting]]
****[[United Kingdom government]] officials confirm that a man was accidentally flown from [[Kabul]] to [[Birmingham]], [[England]], where he was flagged as being a part of a [[terrorist]] [[no-fly list]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-58311964 (BBC News)]
***[[Operation Allies Refuge]]
****[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Joe Biden]] says that around 70,000 people have been evacuated from [[Afghanistan]]. He also announces that the United States will stick to its August 31 deadline, but says that there should be "contingency plans" if necessary. [https://kvia.com/your-voice-your-vote/politics/2021/08/24/watch-biden-says-u-s-has-evacuated-over-70000-from-afghanistan/ (KVIA-TV)] [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/afghanistan-evacuation-withdrawal-deadline-biden-address-watch-live-stream-today-2021-08-24/ (CBS News)]
****[[United States House of Representatives|Representatives]] [[Peter Meijer]] ([[Republican Party (United States)|R]]-[[Michigan|MI]]) and [[Seth Moulton]] ([[Democratic Party (United States)|D]]-[[Massachusetts|MA]]) make an unannounced trip to [[Kabul]] "to conduct oversight on the mission to evacuate Americans and our allies". However, the [[United States Department of State|U.S. State Department]], [[United States Department of Defense|Defense Department]], and [[Speaker of the United States House of Representatives|House Speaker]] [[Nancy Pelosi]] issue a warning for lawmakers not to travel to Afghanistan. [https://www.politico.com/news/2021/08/24/us-lawmakers-in-afghanistan-506834 (''Politico'')]
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**[[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|Al-Shabaab]] [[insurgent]]s attack a [[military base]] in [[Galmudug]] and capture the town of [[List of cities in Somalia|Amara]] after [[Somali forces]] retreat. The Somali forces conduct [[airstrike]]s and say that they have killed insurgents. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/al-shabaab-attacks-somali-military-base-captures-central-town-2021-08-24/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*At least 12 [[mineral industry of Colombia|miners]] are dead during an explosion of [[methane gas]] and [[coal dust]] in the "La Carbonera" mine, in the municipality of [[Tópaga]], [[Colombia]]. [https://www.perthnow.com.au/news/colombian-mine-blast-kills-12-c-3777384?fbclid=IwAR14eRBadGvViv8-mK95EFa1Dnii7W-cCimGeOMJINrR5MuPjbgWTw6XqFA (''PerthNow'')]
*An apartment collapses in [[Turin]], [[Italy]] during a suspected [[gas leak]], killing a child and wounding three more people. [https://www.ansa.it/english/news/general_news/2021/08/24/boy-4-killed-in-building-collapse-in-turin_cd2e3231-27eb-412c-96d6-b5d39d9c6376.html (Agenzia Nazionale Stampa Associata)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Cambodia]]
****[[Cambodia]] surpasses 90,000 cases of [[COVID-19]]. [https://www.khmertimeskh.com/50921987/cambodia-passes-90000-case-mark-but-official-daily-totals-still-low/ (''Khmer Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in India]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in India]]
****[[India]] approves the phase II and III trials of the country's first domestic [[MRNA]]-based [[HGC019]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] made by Gennova Biopharmaceuticals after the early-stage study found that the vaccine is safe and effective. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/8/24/india-approves-further-trials-for-homegrown-mrna-covid-19-shot (Al Jazeera)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia]]
****[[Indonesia]] surpasses four million cases of COVID-19. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/asiapacific/2021-08/24/c_1310145955.htm (Xinhua News Agency)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iran]]
****[[Iran]] reports a record 709 deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 103,357. [https://www.barrons.com/news/iran-covid-deaths-hit-yet-another-high-01629804608 (''Barron's'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Israel]]
****[[Israel]] surpasses one million cases of COVID-19. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/israel-passes-1-million-total-covid-cases-approaches-one-day-record/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the State of Palestine]]
****A [[U.S.]] donation of 500,000 doses of the [[Moderna COVID-19 vaccine]] via [[COVAX]] Initiative is arrived in [[Gaza Strip]] and [[West Bank]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/us-donation-covid-19-vaccines-arrives-west-bank-gaza-2021-08-24/ (Reuters)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Greece]]
****The [[Greece|Greek]] [[Government of Greece|government]] announces new measures that would require [[COVID-19 testing]] for all unvaccinated employees and university students at their own expense with the exception of school students and also restrict access to restaurants, bars, cafés, and indoor entertainment and sport venues to only those who have been [[COVID-19 vaccination in Greece|vaccinated]] or who have recovered from COVID-19. The new rules will be in effect from September 13 until March 31, 2022. [https://apnews.com/article/europe-business-health-greece-coronavirus-pandemic-9656434341e8db7aa36fd73a2cbbb50c (Associated Press)]
****Greece reports a record 4,608 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 566,812. [https://www.ekathimerini.com/news/1166751/greece-sets-new-record-for-new-covid-cases/ (''Kathimerini'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in France]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in France]]
****The [[France|French]] national health regulator ''Haute Autorité de Santé'' recommends a [[booster dose]] of the COVID-19 vaccine for people over the age of 65 and those with existing health conditions, which was previously announced by [[Minister of Health (France)|Health minister]] [[Olivier Véran]] yesterday. The booster doses will be administered beginning at the end of October. [https://www.euronews.com/2021/08/24/french-backs-covid-booster-jab-initiative-for-those-65-and-older (Euronews)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Turkey]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Turkey]]
****The number of COVID-19 vaccine doses administered in [[Turkey]] surpasses 90 million. [https://www.hurriyetdailynews.com/over-90-million-doses-of-virus-jab-administered-167328 (''Hürriyet Daily News'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Cuba]]
***[[Cuba]] reports a record 9,907 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 602,526. [https://www.sify.com/news/cuba-registers-record-number-of-9907-daily-covid-cases-news-international-vizc4jdfbeefi.html (Sify)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in New Zealand]]
***[[New Zealand]] reports 41 new community transmitted cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, which is the highest single-day total of new cases since April 2020. [https://www.afr.com/world/pacific/new-zealand-has-highest-jump-in-covid-19-cases-since-april-2020-20210824-p58lkx (''Australian Financial Review'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Nigeria]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Nigeria]]
***The [[National Agency for Food and Drug Administration and Control]] approves the [[Sinopharm]] [[BBIBP-CorV]] vaccine for emergency use in [[Nigeria]]. [https://www.vanguardngr.com/2021/08/fg-approves-sinopharm-covid-19-vaccine-2/ (''Vanguard'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***The U.S. surpasses 38 million cases of COVID-19. [https://www.kiro7.com/news/trending/coronavirus-total-us-covid-19-cases-top-38m-death-toll-passes-630k/KUCAY27CFBHBBHQBF3DKORNCBM/ (KIRO-TV)]
*[[Havana syndrome]]
**[[Vice President of the United States|U.S. Vice President]] [[Kamala Harris]]'s trip to [[Vietnam]] from [[Singapore]] is postponed for several hours following reports of cases of [[Havana syndrome]] in [[Hanoi]]. Additionally, two other U.S. staff are evacuated from the country. [https://www.forbes.com/sites/graisondangor/2021/08/24/kamala-harris-vietnam-visit-reportedly-held-up-by-havana-syndrome-scare/?sh=6e9b131d64ad (''Forbes'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Algeria–Morocco relations]]
**[[Algeria]] suspends diplomatic ties with [[Morocco]] in an unprecedented move in which [[List of Ministers of Foreign Affairs of Algeria|Foreign Minister]] [[Ramtane Lamamra|Ramdane Lamamra]] accused Morocco of "hostile actions". [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/8/24/algeria-cuts-diplomatic-ties-with-morocco (Al Jazeera)] 

'''Law and crime'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic in Guatemala]]
**The [[Congress of the Republic of Guatemala|Congress of the Republic]] rejects the approval of the [[state of calamity]] which, among other measures, imposed a curfew between 10 p.m. and 4 a.m. in addition to restrictions on [[Freedom of movement|mobility]] and [[freedom of assembly]]. [[President of Guatemala|President]] [[Alejandro Giammattei]] defended the entry into force of these measures on August 13 as reducing the spread of the [[SARS-CoV-2 Delta variant]]. [https://www.telesurenglish.net/news/Guatemalan-Congress-Repeals-State-of-Calamity-Decree-20210824-0006.html (Telesur)]
*[[Capital punishment in Japan]]
**A senior member of the [[yakuza]], [[Satoru Nomura]], is [[sentenced to death]] by a court in [[Fukuoka]], [[Japan]], for ordering four assaults, one of which was deadly. Nomura has denied participating in the crimes. It is the first time that a senior member of the [[Crime in Japan|crime group]] has been sentenced to death. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-58321573 (BBC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Andrew Cuomo sexual harassment allegations]]
**[[Andrew Cuomo]]'s [[resignation]] as [[Governor of New York]] comes into effect. [[Lieutenant Governor of New York|Lieutenant Governor]] [[Kathy Hochul]] is sworn in, making her the [[List of governors of New York|first woman to serve as governor]] of [[New York (state)|New York]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/politics-news/hochul-be-sworn-n-y-s-first-woman-governor-after-n1277462 (NBC News)]
*[[2021 Zambian general election]]
**[[Hakainde Hichilema]] is sworn in as the 7th [[President of Zambia|president]], succeeding [[Edgar Lungu]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/8/24/zambian-opposition-leader-takes-oath-of-office-for-presidency (Al Jazeera)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2020 Summer Paralympics]]
**[[COVID-19 cases at the 2020 Summer Olympics and 2020 Summer Paralympics]]
***The [[Tokyo Organising Committee of the Olympic and Paralympic Games]] reports the first COVID-19 case involving a [[Paralympic athlete]]. The athlete tested positive for COVID-19 at the [[Harumi Futo|Olympic village]] and was taken to an isolation facility. [https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2021/aug/24/first-athlete-tests-positive-for-covid-19-in-tokyo-paralympic-village (''The Guardian'')]
**The [[2020 Summer Paralympics opening ceremony|opening ceremony]] for the Paralympics is held. During the ceremony, the [[Flag of Afghanistan|Afghanistan flag]] is flown despite the [[Afghanistan at the Paralympics|withdrawal]] of the country's athletes. [https://www.cnn.com/2021/08/24/sport/paralympics-opening-ceremony-tokyo-spt-intl/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/olympics/2021/08/24/afghanistan-flag-held-during-2020-paralympic-games-athletes-not-there/8254329002/ (''USA Today'')]
